lane:
زغرد

زغردة زَغْرَدَةٌ The _braying that is reiterated_ (L, K) _in the fauces,_ or _throat,_ (L,) or _in the_ جَوْف [meaning _chest_], (K,) of the camel: (L, K:) an inf. n., of which the verb is زَغْرَدَ: you say, زَغْرَدَ البَعِيرُ. (TK.) === Hence the زَغْرَدَة of women on the occasions of rejoicings. (TA.) [One says, of a woman, زَغْرَدَتْ, more commonly in the present day زَغْرَطَتْ, meaning _She uttered shrill, quavering,_ or _rapidly-reiterated, sounds,_ or _cries of joy:_ which sounds, or cries, are termed ↓زَغَارِيدُ, and now more commonly زَغَارِيط.]

زغاريد زَغَارِيدُ : see above.

entries.text: زغرد: الزَّغْرَدَةُ: هدير يردده الفحل في حلقه.|
الزغردة: هدير للإبل يردده في جوفه.
